verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI agent product; all MCP evidence (poke-docs-3,4,16) shows Poke acting as an MCP *client*—connecting to or tunneling external MCP servers to extend its own capabilities—not Poke exposing an official MCP server endpoint for other agents to connect to. Per the agent-role rule, this client-side capability does not make the 'official MCP server' axis applicable.
